Metadata.title: L'Amour Bloom — everlasting handmade flowers
Metadata.description: Preserved and mixed-media floral pieces delivered across Georgia. Bouquets, wall décor, wedding florals, and gift sets that never wilt.

Home.title: Flowers that never fade.
Home.subtitle: Preserved botanicals and mixed-media compositions, made to last and shipped to every region of Georgia — not only the big cities.
Home.promise1Body: Preserved, dried, and mixed-media flowers keep their shape and colour. Overnight perishability is not a constraint.
Home.promise2Body: We ship to Tbilisi, regional cities, and villages. Choose your region at checkout for an accurate delivery rate.
Home.promise3Body: Each piece is assembled by hand. Variants let you pick size and colour without guessing from a single photo.
